name: Seiki Koyou ~Seiyaku Gaisha no Shinjin Kyouiku "Ichinichi Ichijou, Watashi Mi mo Kokoro mo Sasagemasu!"~
original_name: 性器雇用　～製薬会社の新人狂育「一日一錠、わたし身も心も捧げます！」～
source:
Mika starts working at a pharmaceutical company. However, the company has a secret. New workers are in charge of a special job. They are given a pill every day and sent to various departments, to be respectable workers!

[From Erogeshop]
